title: skills: teach declaring an action's texts (ActionSchema.texts) and translating them under the action node — objectstack-ui rules/actions.md and objectstack-i18n SKILL.md
body:
triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Filed by triage at the request of repo:objectstack#3 (area o3-G, mailbox #32588, 6967686326, item 2). It is a follow-up owed before PR #35085 closes #34374.

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` and `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` should teach declaring `texts` on an action, and translating them under the action node in a bundle. This is not covered elsewhere:
- #35087 (#34824) teaches action **refusals**, not texts;
- #34546 covers only the hook half.

Done when both skill texts carry it, plus one eval case. `skills/**` is governed (Tier H, L2).

Grade: **p2 · domain:skills**. Theme: MCP and zh-CN (skills teach external agents to author). Routed to seat 4; seat 3 is winding down.
